name: Lukka
description: Lukka is a planeswalker and beast-bonder from Ikoria, a former captain of the Specials, who was compleated on New Phyrexia and became a Phyrexian evangel.

description_citations.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
description_citations.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

summary.text: Lukka is a planeswalker and beast-bonder from Ikoria, a former captain of the Specials, who was compleated on New Phyrexia and became a Phyrexian evangel.

bio.text: On Arcavios he was mistaken for an Oriq recruiter by villagers, then bonded with an injured fox-like creature and named her Mila.

citations.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

bio.text: He refused the Oriq's silver skull mask and Kasmina fought him, but he worked with the Oriq leader Extus and controlled the mage hunters against Strixhaven.

bio.text: When dragonfire killed the mage hunters, he severed the link and fled with Mila, deciding it was no longer his fight.

"Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

bio.text: He later joined the group that planeswalked in to travel with the sylex.

citations.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 5: Exodus" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

bio.text: On New Phyrexia he used the eludha to dominate a Phyrexian centaur hulk and helped Nissa and the Wanderer, but Phyrexian rootlets and metal were growing inside him.

status.text: As of May 2023 a page records Ajani saying that Lukka is dead, after his compleation and being sent to Ikoria as an evangel.

citations.work: March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless
citations.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Masked Oriq mages ambush Lukka and Mila in a desert and take Lukka prisoner.
timeline.quote: Slowly, he raised his hands in surrender.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: In the cave Lukka senses shelled creatures hanging around them.
timeline.quote: Slowly, whatever it was seemed to unfold, stretching long and spindly legs into the darkness.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: A masked man greets Lukka by name and offers to teach him in exchange for favors.
timeline.quote: Welcome to Arcavios, Lukka of Ikoria.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Three weeks earlier, Lukka planeswalks to Arcavios and wanders to a small farming village (flashback).
timeline.quote: his stomach still churning from planeswalking

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Villagers accuse Lukka of being an Oriq recruiter and threaten him.
timeline.quote: Okay, Oriq, I think I've heard enough.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Lukka punches one man, then is knocked through a window by another's firebolt.
timeline.quote: Lukka got a few steps away before the firebolt splashed against the back of his coat

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Lukka calls village animals to attack his attackers and staggers away hungry.
timeline.quote: a dog leapt through the air, its sharp teeth flashing as they sank into his arm

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Starving Lukka nearly falls from a crumbling cliff ledge.
timeline.quote: The ledge suddenly gave way beneath him, crumbling into loose stone.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Lukka finds an injured fox-like creature under a pile of stones.
timeline.quote: A pair of golden eyes looked back out at him.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: The fox leaves berries and nuts beside the fainted Lukka.
timeline.quote: A pile of berries and nuts lay beside his leg.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Lukka forms a bond with the fox-like creature.
timeline.quote: Lukka took a deep breath and cast out his bonder's senses.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Lukka watches a Dragonsguard confront masked Oriq agents.
timeline.quote: he could see a woman wearing immaculate robes facing a group of masked individuals

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: The Dragonsguard reflects an Oriq curse that nearly hits Lukka and rots a tree.
timeline.quote: He ducked just in time, the spell hissing horribly as it flew overhead and hit a tree to his right.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Lukka summons the forest beasts to the clearing.
timeline.quote: Connecting with the nearby beasts, he summoned each and every one to the clearing.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: The Dragonsguard traps Lukka waist-deep in soil, calling him an untrained Oriq hedge-mage.
timeline.quote: the root creeping around his own ankle until it yanked him into the soil down to his waist

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: The fox-like creature attacks the Dragonsguard with fire and fells her.
timeline.quote: a familiar shape stood over the Dragonsguard's still body, her fiery tail twitching as she sniffed at her fallen opponent

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Lukka renews the bond and names the creature Mila.
timeline.quote: Mila it is.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus learns of a beast-calling stranger and says to let him come.
timeline.quote: Let him come.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina's owl sees a masked Oriq agent offer Lukka a silver skull mask, which he refuses.
timeline.quote: It was a silver mask, shaped like a human skull.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina confronts Lukka at the edge of the courtyard and he refuses to be anyone's pawn.
timeline.quote: It's a shame to see a man like you fallen so far.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina and Lukka fight with wind and blade.
timeline.quote: Kasmina sent a scythe of pressurized air straight at Lukka's chest.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina warns Lukka that Extus fights only for himself.
timeline.quote: Do you think Extus is going to change all that?

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina pins Lukka with her staff and demands he yield.
timeline.quote: Before he could get up, Kasmina was there, the point of her staff held just under his chin.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: A swarm of mage hunters approaches the school, and Lukka says they are just getting started.
timeline.quote: a swarm of chitinous, chittering forms scurried between the trees

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus orders the Oriq to attack as Lukka controls the mage hunters.
timeline.quote: Commence the attack.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Across campus, Lukka feels the roar while controlling the mage hunters and tells Mila that Extus got what he wanted.
timeline.quote: It found Lukka, even through the concentration it took from him to keep all the mage hunters fighting on several fronts.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dragonfire kills nearby mage hunters, and Lukka severs the link to avoid being overwhelmed.
timeline.quote: he severed the link before he could be overwhelmed

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Lukka decides this is no longer his fight and flees with Mila.
timeline.quote: Calling Mila to his side, Lukka turned and ran into the dark.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina sees Lukka wandering with Mila and remaining Oriq, but turns her attention to the twins.
timeline.quote: But he was no longer worth watching.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Vraska, the Wanderer, Kaito, Tyvar and Lukka planeswalk in to join, and Kaya wraps the sylex for the journey.
timeline.quote: Soon, others began to planeswalk in.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 5: Exodus" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Lukka arrives in the wrong location on New Phyrexia, separated from the strike team, and recalls why he joined the mission.
timeline.quote: He wasn't with the rest of the strike team.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Lukka decides to climb a tree in the Hunter Maze rather than planeswalk, hoping to dominate a creature to chart a route.
timeline.quote: No, he'd go high, try to make it back to the others.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Lukka follows an angry cry and finds Nissa and the Wanderer fighting a Phyrexian construct on a bough.
timeline.quote: Lukka had seen them before: Nissa, and the woman was called . . . the Wanderer.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Lukka uses the eludha to freeze a second Phyrexian creeping above them, saving Nissa and the Wanderer from an ambush.
timeline.quote: Lukka reached out with the eludha, the bond he could forge between himself and another creature.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Lukka proposes using the dominated Phyrexian as a guide and Nissa reluctantly agrees after he promises to kill it at any sign of trouble.
timeline.quote: if I get so much as a stomachache, I'll end the creature.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Lukka and Nissa ride the centaur hulk up a tree, with Lukka irritated by Nissa's heels and recalling a childhood beating.
timeline.quote: Five to one.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer warns them of a Phyrexian monstrosity that attacks Nissa; the centaur hulk wraps wires around Lukka's spine and he kills the attacker with his harpoon.
timeline.quote: Veiny wires sprouted from its torso, plunging through his skin and wiggling through his gut to wrap around his spine.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Intrusive thoughts begin whispering power and strength to Lukka as they climb higher through the canopy.
timeline.quote: You deserve power. You are strong. Here, strength is rewarded. The weak are culled.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Lukka discovers Phyrexian rootlets still inside him, and instead of fear feels healthier and stronger.
timeline.quote: He felt healthier, stronger, more confident

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The group is attacked by leech-like creatures and a mother-beast; Lukka frees his Phyrexian by slicing through the mother-monstrosity with his now-metallic hands.
timeline.quote: He pulled apart a lip of flesh and freed his Phyrexian.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Lukka notices a maggot-like wriggling and metal under a scab on his arm and feels no pain.
timeline.quote: A bone-deep wound, he marveled, and it didn't even hurt.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer reveals Vorinclex is nearby and recovered from his journey to Kaldheim, and Lukka and Nissa decide to attack him.
timeline.quote: We need to take him down before he hurts anyone else.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: At the center of the maze they find Vorinclex sparring joyfully with Glissa.
timeline.quote: Vorinclex fought a Phyrexian elf beneath the monstrous skulls that hung from the ceiling.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Lukka charges in against Glissa while Nissa fights Vorinclex.
timeline.quote: Without another word, Lukka charged in.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Lukka merges with the Phyrexian centaur hulk, gaining a second set of arms and compleating.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexian flowed into him.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Nissa, horrified, backs away as Lukka advances on her, and the Wanderer flickers in to shield her and tells her to run.
timeline.quote: Nissa, run!

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Glissa takes command of Lukka, ordering him to find but not kill Nissa, and Lukka sets out hunting.
timeline.quote: Find the elf, Lukka. But do not kill her.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Lukka, Ajani, Atraxa and Nahiri bring in the bound Sheoldred as an offering.
timeline.quote: Carried like a trussed up offering between them is the once powerful Sheoldred.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Norn sends Lukka to Ikoria to add its monsters to Phyrexian ranks, warning him of the price of failure.
timeline.quote: Go to Ikoria. Add these monsters to our ranks.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo and Atraxa discuss Lukka's likely fate and Norn's strategy.
timeline.quote: Either way Phyrexia is served.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

relations.note: She fights him to stop his path.
relations.quote: I'm not going to let you do that, Lukka.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

pages_say.description: A beast-bonded man from Ikoria captured on Arcavios by masked mages and brought before a masked man.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 5: Exodus" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

pages_say.description: A planeswalker whose whereabouts are unknown.

citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.
